dest:changzhou:why1.note: Bronze hand sculpture in the Chunqiu Yancheng Scenic Area, Changzhou, against a rock face. The reason wording was not in the shard: judge must check it against the reason (Yancheng ruins park). Encyclopedia image, so not an official photo.

spot:changzhou-6.note: Brick-and-glass campus building and covered walkway with the Chinese campus name sign on the wall. Captioned Canal 5 Creativity Campus. Visible signage is small; judge to check it is the campus and not a neighbouring building.
